summary: BP p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, reporting routine notifications of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMRs) under its ShareMatch UK Plan. The filing lists four directors/PDMRs—Kate Thomson (CFO), Michael Sosso, Gordon Birrell, and Kerry Dryburgh—each acquiring small numbers of ordinary shares at £5.359 per share on 11 May 2026, in off-exchange transactions. No special situation event is present; the filing exclusively contains standard share acquisition disclosures for a foreign private issuer's equity incentive plan. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change elements. The Form 6-K serves as a report of foreign issuer under Rule 13a-16, mapping to a routine insider transaction filing comparable to a U.S. Form 4. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
